text:
mira: Heads-up — post-change SLO exit checks. I pushed the final traffic shift for inference-api v3.2.1 ~5m ago. Running quick p95/p99 and 5xx sweep. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-exit

deploy-bot: rollout complete -> inference-api v3.2.1 at 2024-10-12T15:02Z

observability-bot: SLO monitor: p95 latency 420ms (baseline 310ms) in last 5m; error rate 0.62% (threshold 0.5%); alert: warn. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/1009

alex: I'm seeing tail traces pointing to high wait on tokenizer shard. Small number of 5xx look like BadRequest from tokenization.

sam: If error rate stays >0.5% for 10m we should pin back to v3.2.0. Can we split 20% to fallback to validate stability?

mira: Doing a quick fallback split -> routing 20% to v3.2.0 now. Will monitor next 5m.

ops-bot: traffic-split updated: inference-api -> v3.2.1:80% v3.2.0:20% (by mira)

li: DB traces look clean; no uptick. Likely tokenizer behavior causing larger batch sizes and tail latency. Patch to revert tokenizer change is queued.

alex: Suggest temporary runtime tweak: reduce inference.max_batch_size to 8 for prod. I'll apply on infer-rack-3 first.

mira: Applying runtime-config: `runtime-config set inference.max_batch_size=8 --env=prod` (rolling change)

observability-bot: SLO monitor: p95 down to 330ms; error rate dropped to 0.35% — within SLOs. No active alerts.

mira: Rolling traffic back to v3.2.1 100% in 2m if metrics stay stable.

ops-bot: traffic-split updated: inference-api -> v3.2.1:100% (by mira)

sam: I'll update release notes: call out tokenizer regression + temporary batch-size mitigation and pin in deploy tool for next patch. Link: https://docs.redwood/releases/v3.2.1-notes

mira: Marking this mitigated. Adding postmortem item: add tokenizer regression test and e2e on batch-size distribution to CI. Thanks team :thumbsup:

alex: +1

sam: thanks — filing follow-up ticket R-INF-2209

mira: closing runbook check. If anyone sees re-escalation, reopen thread.
